text_block_list.text: The Takarazuka Kinen has finally arrived—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"It looks like so many people
have come to cheer us on today~."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It looks like that reporter who often comes
to interview us is here as well.
choice_data_list: Let's show them who you are now!
Let's show them who you are now!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Without flinching or hesitating, I shall march forward...
And show you everything I've got!
Having finished her preparations, Grass Wonder left the waiting room with a far brighter expression than before.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Uuugh, I'm so nervous, so nervous...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan.
I look forward to working with you today~

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
T-Thank goodness~
I'm so glad we got to talk before the start...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my~.
Spe-chan, you look awfully stiff and nervous.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The Takarazuka Kinen is a race you cannot enter
unless recognized and chosen by the fans.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
There are so many people in the stands cheering
for you, Spe-chan, so shouldn't you hold
your head high?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ahaha... Hmm, I'm super happy that they're cheering for me, though.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Still, I just kept feeling like Grass-chan
and the others were so much more amazing than me—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Whoops, look at the time!
I gotta run.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes. Let's both give it our absolute best.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: "...'Where there's a will, there's a way. If you don't try, nothing will ever come to pass; for failure lies only in not trying.'"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...My path begins right here, right now!
